prompt: Create a cinematic vertical 3D cartoon scene on a realistic forest floor, framed like a mobile video still. In the center foreground, show one cute miniature bearded man, Montaser, with an oversized caricature head and worried expression, standing stiffly with arms slightly out while trapped in a large white spider web behind him. He has short dark brown hair, a trimmed beard, raised sad eyebrows, and big anxious eyes. Dress him in exactly four main outfit pieces: a dark denim jacket, a gray T-shirt, black pants, and white sneakers. To his right, show one giant glossy black cartoon ant with large expressive eyes, two antennae, six thin legs, and bent forearms, leaning toward him with a curious intimidating look. Behind them, the spider web radiates clearly across green leaves and stems. At the top center, add a game-style scoreboard overlay: a dark rounded rectangle with exactly two circular avatar icons, the left icon showing the man on a blue background, the right icon showing the ant on an orange background, and large white score text 2 - 1 between them. The environment is a macro-scale forest floor with dirt, small pebbles, tiny plants, blurred green foliage, warm daylight, shallow depth of field, and cinematic bokeh. Use polished Pixar-like 3D rendering, soft realistic lighting, detailed textures, playful comedy tension, and a vertical 9:16 composition. Add a small white stylized logo watermark at the bottom right reading MONTASER.

promptZh: 创建一个电影感垂直 3D 卡通场景，呈现真实的森林地面，构图如同手机视频截图。在前景中央，展示一个可爱的微型留胡子男人，Montaser，他有着夸张的卡通大头和焦虑的表情，僵硬地站着，双臂微微张开，被困在身后的巨大白色蜘蛛网中。他留着深棕色短发，修剪整齐的胡须，眉头紧锁，眼神充满不安。他穿着四件套服装：深色牛仔夹克、灰色 T 恤、黑色长裤和白色运动鞋。在他的右侧，展示一只巨大的亮黑色卡通蚂蚁，它有着大而有神的眼睛、两根触角、六条细腿和弯曲的前臂，正带着好奇且具有威胁感的表情向他倾斜。在他们身后，蜘蛛网清晰地放射状覆盖在绿叶和茎秆上。在顶部中央，添加一个游戏风格的记分牌叠加层：一个深色圆角矩形，内有两个圆形头像图标，左侧图标显示蓝色背景下的男人，右侧图标显示橙色背景下的蚂蚁，中间是巨大的白色分数文本 2 - 1。环境为宏观视角下的森林地面，包含泥土、小石子、微型植物、模糊的绿色叶片、温暖的日光、浅景深和电影级光斑效果。采用精致的 Pixar 风格 3D 渲染、柔和写实的灯光、细腻的纹理、俏皮的喜剧张力以及 9:16 的垂直构图。在右下角添加一个白色的小型风格化标志水印，文字为 MONTASER。
